name: Old Friday Mosque (Badjanani Mosque) and the medina
subtitle: The Old Friday Mosque stands in the medina of Moroni, opposite the old dhow harbour.

facts.label: Date
facts.value: Built in 830 AH (1427 CE) per Mayotte Hebdo

facts.label: Setting
facts.value: Part of Moroni's medina, with a green minaret

facts.label: Standing
facts.value: Called the city's most famous building

facts.label: Medina
facts.value: Medinas of the islands are lived-in historic quarters

parts.text: The Old Friday Mosque stands in the medina of Moroni, opposite the old dhow harbour. It is described as the most famous building in the city and dated by Mayotte Hebdo to 1427.

gaps: The description is summarised from the sources listed here and should be read against them.
